purpose: Integrate the current target-candidate lattice, source-aware rare-program preservation, authenticated multimodal evidence, and the existing EMA runtime without requiring the partial-RNA student to reproduce teacher-private biology.

scientific_model.teacher_state: Z_core ⊕ Z_query ⊕ Z_rel_if_qualified ⊕ Z_reg_shared ⊕ Z_reg_private ⊕ Z_context_private
forbidden_point_target: exact realized ATAC state when not RNA-identifiable
exact realized spatial neighborhood when not RNA-identifiable
scientific_model.principle: The rich teacher may know more than the student. Teacher-private information is not removed merely to make the student's task easy; recoverable and unrecoverable state are separated empirically.

foundation_target_binding.C2: candidate relational increment for Z_rel_if_qualified; only if corrected replay and later gates keep C2 active
foundation_target_binding.C6: candidate joint Z_core+Z_query scaffold; only after C1 and C3 qualify and C6_INCREMENT_OVER_C1_C3 passes
foundation_target_binding.C4: candidate joint Z_core+Z_query+Z_rel; only if C2 and C3 qualify
foundation_target_binding.C5: regulatory specialist source for Z_reg blocks; never foundation rescue
foundation_target_binding.rare_program_rule: Any selected foundation target must first satisfy TD_RARE_PROGRAM_QUALIFICATION_CONTRACT_V1 and any triggered source/operator-aware reassessment.

teacher_evidence_order: qualified same-nucleus ATAC/regulatory evidence where physically available
separate-nucleus donor-level regulatory replication as support
spatial/context evidence only where measurable and prospectively lawful
perturbational evidence only as qualified support/interpretation unless a separate teacher-feature authority explicitly permits more

teacher_feature_rules.basis_rule: When coordinates rotate but subspace is stable, scientific authority attaches to the stable subspace/geometry rather than arbitrary axes.

source_aware_rare_program_modeling.rule: A rare program may be biologically real even when prevalence differs by source. The model must separate program state from observation-domain support and prevalence.

teacher_behavior.universal_program: Represent program biology in shared teacher state; source/operator descriptors remain support/context, not biological coordinates.
teacher_behavior.source_shifted_prevalence: Represent the program state if biology is source-qualified; do not encode source prevalence itself as a latent biological target.
teacher_behavior.source_specific_biology: Retain as source-specific biological state/context with restricted transport claim; do not promote to universal foundation target.
teacher_behavior.observation_limited_program: Retain biology plus explicit support/measurement uncertainty; missing evidence must not collapse state toward zero or the mean.
teacher_behavior.operator_artifact: Exclude from biological teacher target and record as measurement/domain structure.

student_behavior.recoverable_rare_program: Predict the program state when partial RNA contains sufficient evidence.
student_behavior.weakly_observed_rare_program: Increase measurement/domain uncertainty rather than forcing a common-state prediction.
student_behavior.teacher_private_multimodal_increment: Represent via biological-evidence uncertainty/distributional prediction, not exact deterministic matching.

source_aware_rare_program_modeling.prevalence_modeling: Program identity/state and population prevalence are separate scientific objects; global pooled quantile thresholds are not biological prevalence estimates when source/operator composition differs.

rare_program_role.foundation: Rare programs are a mandatory target-preservation test before target selection.
rare_program_role.teacher: For a frozen rare RNA target state, rich modalities may sharpen regulatory/contextual characterization and reveal teacher-private components.
rare_program_role.student: The student should detect a rare program when RNA contains recoverable evidence and should widen biological or measurement uncertainty when the rich program is not identifiable from its observed RNA.
rare_program_role.novelty_vs_ood: Biological novelty and measurement-domain OOD are separate outputs; a rare, well-measured state must not be auto-corrected toward the population mean.

same_nucleus_identifiability_experiment.quantity_of_interest: Delta_privileged = Z_teacher(RNA+ATAC) - projection_of_Z_teacher(RNA_only) within the stable target geometry
questions: Does privileged ATAC/regulatory evidence sharpen or split a target-defined rare state?
Which privileged increments are donor-held-out predictable from RNA?
Which increments remain teacher-private and should widen biological uncertainty rather than point loss?
Are apparent increments robust to depth/source/support baselines and low-n donor sensitivity?
same_nucleus_identifiability_experiment.split_rule: donor first; no nucleus-level leakage across train/validation/test
same_nucleus_identifiability_experiment.test_rule: Recoverability TEST remains sealed until teacher feature construction, baselines, metrics and selection rule are frozen.

recoverability_classes.DETERMINISTIC_OR_HIGHLY_RECOVERABLE: eligible for student point target after donor-held-out validation and shortcut controls
recoverability_classes.PREDICTABLE_BUT_STOCHASTIC: student predicts distribution/uncertainty, not exact realized teacher coordinate
recoverability_classes.TEACHER_PRIVATE: excluded from deterministic student matching; retained in rich teacher and biological uncertainty
recoverability_classes.NOT_ESTIMABLE: kept unresolved; never mapped to zero or PASS

ema_integration.runtime_reuse: Use the already qualified canonical V5 AdamW->successful-update->EMA mechanics; do not create a second optimizer/EMA engine.
ema_integration.ema_shared_core: EMA stabilizes the shared representation core and any structurally matched teacher/student modules.
ema_integration.privileged_adapters: ATAC/regulatory/spatial teacher adapters may be teacher-only modules; they are not required to be literal EMA copies of nonexistent student modalities.
ema_integration.teacher_age: successful base-cell presentations, not raw attempted steps
ema_integration.failed_update_rule: No optimizer completion means no EMA advance.
ema_integration.scientific_boundary: Runtime qualification does not imply full rich-teacher realization is point-identifiable from partial RNA.

loss_family.shared_state_loss: rotation-aware/subspace-aware deterministic matching on qualified recoverable target blocks
loss_family.query_loss: q-safe query-conditioned target matching with q excluded from target construction and normalization/QC descendants as already required
loss_family.relational_loss: only if C2/C4 remain active after corrected replay and later gates
loss_family.probabilistic_privileged_loss: distributional or uncertainty-calibrated prediction for privileged components shown to be predictable but not deterministic
loss_family.measurement_uncertainty: estimated separately from biological-evidence uncertainty using depth/count resampling rather than conflating the two
loss_family.anti_collapse: required for every target block and for uncertainty outputs

evidence_response.principle: State change as richer biological evidence is revealed estimates biological-evidence uncertainty; state change under repeated/deeper measurement of the same evidence estimates measurement uncertainty.
evidence_response.rare_program_use: Rare states that require substantially more evidence to stabilize are scientifically interesting and should be marked information-poor/uncertain rather than collapsed.

hard_prohibitions: Do not select a foundation target because it gives the strongest downstream AD/pathology association.
Do not force the student to match teacher-private multimodal realization exactly.
Do not treat source/operator identity as biological state.
Do not convert missing privileged evidence to zero.
Do not allow C5 or multimodal evidence to rescue failure of all foundation candidates.
Do not use global source-confounded rare1/rare5 prevalence as biological truth.
Do not authorize real training from this contract.
